note: The two sets are essentially identical in content: both capture all Table 5-1 values plus the 5% critical damping ratio (with its free-free mode condition) and the zero gearbox frictional losses (with the FAST/ADAMS preprocessor condition), all with supporting quotes. The only difference is how the fully-deployed brake torque is framed: Set A puts 'Fully-Deployed' in the conditions field, Set B folds it into the attribute name ('fully-deployed torque'); both are faithful to the source. Neither set contains misread, misbound, or invented values, and both contain the same harmless duplication of table and prose facts.
